records.subject: Re: API pagination
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the question. List endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your Wrenfield workspace — one quick next step
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thank you for the kind words about the onboarding flow — that made our week. Tariq also has your notification badge ticket open and will follow up as he learns more.

Since we missed each other at the kickoff, no worries at all. When you're ready, the simplest next step is creating one real project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Nadia
